snippet.title: Spiritstead - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Spiritstead is a cozy management game where you build a magical village, care for its villagers, and discover the spirits who help your town grow. Assign jobs, manage moods, and balance joy with productivity as you create a world full of charm, cuteness, and surprises.

Coming soon on Steam & Itch.io
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3501540/Spiritstead/?beta=1

Voiceover Credits: Marybelle Sagard
https://www.marybellesagard.com/

#indiegames #cozygames #steam #itchio #cutegames #townbuilding #managementgame
